title: Gmail — Send Email fails with invalid recipient address
problem: The Make Gmail > Send an Email module fails because the recipient email address is invalid, empty, or in a format the Gmail API does not accept.
symptoms: Gmail module fails with a 400 error when attempting to send an email
The To field contains an invalid or empty value
Error is data-dependent — fails for some records but not others

likely_causes.cause: The email address mapped to the To field is empty for this specific record — the source field is optional or absent
The email address contains invalid characters, spaces, or an incorrect format
Multiple email addresses are passed in a format the Gmail module does not accept (e.g., comma-separated when the module expects an array)

diagnosis_steps: Inspect the input bundle of the Gmail module and check the exact value passed to the To field
Verify the email address format — it must be a valid RFC 5321 email address
If the To field is mapped from an optional source field, add a filter before the Gmail module to skip records without a valid email
Check whether the source field can contain multiple addresses and handle them correctly

solutions.solution: Add a filter before the Gmail module checking that the email field exists and is not empty: condition 'email field' 'Exists' AND 'email field' 'Contains' '@'
solutions.conditions: When the email field can be absent or empty in some records

solutions.solution: Use ifempty(1.email; '') and add a filter to skip when the result is empty
solutions.conditions: When the email field is optional

prevention: Always validate email field presence and format before the Gmail module
Never map an optional field directly to the Gmail To field without an existence check

origin_details.evidence: Gmail module requires a valid email address in the To field. Invalid or empty recipients cause the module to fail.

evidence.claim: Make's Gmail > Send an Email module requires a valid email address in the To field
The Gmail API returns a 400 error for invalid recipient email addresses

modules: Any source module (contact list, CRM, spreadsheet)
sequence: some records have empty or invalid email
Gmail module fails on those records
conditions: Email field is optional in source data
No email validation before Gmail module

diagnostic_signals: Gmail module fails for some records but not others
To field contains empty string or invalid format
audit_notes: Gmail module documented in Make Help Center. Specific error message text not confirmed verbatim — error_messages left empty. Gmail API 400 for invalid recipients is consistent with Gmail API documentation.

title: Gmail — Email attachment exceeds Gmail size limit
problem: The Make Gmail > Send an Email module fails when an attachment exceeds Gmail's size limit (25 MB per email for the Gmail API). The module cannot send the email and returns an error.
symptoms: Gmail module fails specifically when attachments are included
The error does not occur when the same email is sent without the attachment
The attachment file size is close to or exceeds 25 MB

likely_causes.cause: The total email size (including attachment) exceeds Gmail's 25 MB limit for the Gmail API

diagnosis_steps: Check the size of the file being attached
Calculate the total email size (body + attachment) — base64 encoding adds approximately 33% overhead
Verify whether the Gmail API limit is 25 MB for the total message size

solutions.solution: Upload the file to Google Drive and share a link in the email body instead of attaching the file directly
solutions.conditions: When the attachment exceeds the Gmail size limit and sharing a link is acceptable

solutions.solution: Compress or reduce the file size before attaching if the file can be reduced below the limit
solutions.conditions: When file compression is acceptable for the use case

prevention: Check file sizes before attaching to Gmail — add a filter to route large files to a Drive-link approach
Default to Google Drive links for any file that could exceed the size limit

origin_details.evidence: Gmail API imposes a 25 MB limit on total message size including attachments.

evidence.claim: Gmail's API enforces a message size limit of 25 MB, including attachments

modules: File source module (Google Drive, HTTP, etc.)
sequence: Gmail API rejects due to size
conditions: Attachment size exceeds Gmail 25 MB limit

diagnostic_signals: Gmail module fails when attachments are present but works without them
Attachment file size is near or above 25 MB
400 error from Gmail module with attachment
audit_notes: Gmail 25 MB limit is documented in Gmail API documentation. Make-specific error message not confirmed verbatim. The Google Drive link alternative is a widely recommended pattern.

title: Gmail — Make connection missing required Gmail scope
problem: A Gmail module attempts an action (e.g., sending email, reading labels, managing drafts) that requires a Gmail OAuth2 scope not granted when the Make connection was created. The module fails with a permission or forbidden error.
symptoms: A Gmail module fails with a forbidden or permission error
Other Gmail modules using the same connection work — the issue is specific to one action
Error started after adding a new Gmail module that uses a different Gmail feature

likely_causes.cause: The Make Gmail connection was created with limited OAuth2 scopes — the new module requires a scope not granted at connection time

diagnosis_steps: Identify which Gmail operation is failing (send, read, labels, drafts, etc.)
Check the Gmail API documentation for the OAuth2 scope required for that operation
Go to Make > Connections and check or recreate the Gmail connection granting all required scopes

solutions.solution: Delete the existing Gmail connection in Make and recreate it, ensuring all required Gmail OAuth2 scopes are granted during the Google authorization step
solutions.conditions: When the connection was created with insufficient scopes

prevention: When creating a Gmail connection, grant all scopes needed by all Gmail modules you plan to use
Test each new Gmail module with the existing connection before deploying to catch scope issues early

origin_details.evidence: Gmail module requires specific OAuth2 scopes depending on the action. Make's Gmail connection must be authorized with the correct scopes.

evidence.claim: Different Gmail operations require different OAuth2 scopes — sending requires gmail.send, reading requires gmail.readonly, etc.

sequence: new module requires scope not in connection
conditions: Gmail connection created before adding the new module
New module requires different OAuth2 scope

diagnostic_signals: Other Gmail modules with the same connection work
audit_notes: Gmail OAuth2 scopes are documented in Gmail API documentation. Make's connection scope behavior is consistent with auth-insufficient-scope entry.

title: Gmail Watch Emails trigger not firing on new emails
problem: A Make scenario using the Gmail > Watch Emails trigger does not activate when new emails arrive matching the configured filters. The scenario appears active but receives no data.
symptoms: Scenario using Gmail Watch Emails is active but does not trigger on new emails
Emails matching the filter are present in Gmail but the scenario did not execute
The scenario last ran much earlier than expected

likely_causes.cause: The Gmail label or search filter configured in the Watch module does not match the emails — they arrive in a different label or with different attributes
Make's Gmail watch trigger uses polling, not push — there is an inherent delay between email arrival and trigger firing based on the scenario schedule
The scenario is scheduled at a low frequency and emails arrive in between polls

diagnosis_steps: Verify the Gmail label or search filter in the Watch Emails module matches the incoming emails
Check the scenario schedule — Gmail Watch uses polling, not instant push. The trigger frequency determines the check interval.
Manually run the scenario with 'Run once' to verify it can find the emails when triggered
Check whether the emails are in the correct Gmail label and match the search criteria

solutions.solution: Increase the scenario schedule frequency (e.g., every 1 or 5 minutes) to reduce the delay between email arrival and processing
solutions.conditions: When the polling delay is the issue and lower latency is required

solutions.solution: Correct the Gmail label or search filter to match the actual labels or attributes of the incoming emails
solutions.conditions: When the filter does not match the incoming emails

prevention: Test the Watch Emails configuration with 'Run once' before scheduling
Understand that Gmail Watch is a polling trigger — for near-real-time processing, use the highest practical polling frequency
search_keywords: make gmail watch emails not triggering

origin_details.evidence: Gmail Watch Emails is a polling trigger in Make — it checks for new emails at the scenario's scheduled interval, not via push.

evidence.claim: Make's Gmail > Watch Emails is a polling trigger — it checks for new emails based on the scenario's execution schedule

sequence: email found or missed depending on timing
conditions: Filter does not match incoming email

diagnostic_signals: Scenario is active but no recent executions
Emails matching filter exist in Gmail but scenario did not process them
Run once manually finds the emails
audit_notes: Gmail Watch as a polling trigger is confirmed in Make documentation. Filter mismatch as a cause is logical and community-confirmed. Specific polling implementation details may vary.
